verdict.rationale: Slack's Web API (docs.slack.dev/apis/web-api, chat.postMessage) explicitly supports posting and reading channel messages via scoped bot/user tokens, and the official OpenAPI spec confirms coverage of user/bot token scopes; the MCP server further lets agents search, read, and send messages with admin-controlled scoped integrations. A live probe confirms the documented Web API endpoint is real and token-gated as described. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of an actual scoped chat.postMessage/read call succeeding (only the keyless api.test endpoint was probed) and no third-party audit of token scope enforcement.
